tasks.title: No sleeve monetises cross-asset lead / lag
tasks.description: The book holds 31 nominal sleeves at an effective breadth of 1.324 (4 of 15 declared phenomena occupied). Cross-asset lead / lag is EMPTY. Who pays: Slow updaters. One market prices news before another that shares the same driver, because its participants watch a different screen. What to hunt: A driver that moves first (rates, oil, the index future) against an instrument that prices it late; the edge is the lag, measured in bars, not the correlation. Because k_eff = n/(1+(n-1)rho) is concave in n, the FIRST sleeve of an unoccupied phenomenon buys more breadth than the next five inside an occupied one -- propose a mechanism whose payer is the one named here, on the MT5/Fusion universe, not a re-parameterisation of what the book already trades.

Because k_eff = n/(1+(n-1)rho) is concave in n, the FIRST sleeve of an unoccupied phenomenon buys more breadth than the next five inside an occupied one -- propose a mechanism whose payer is the one named here, on the MT5/Fusion universe, not a re-parameterisation of what the book already trades.

tasks.title: No sleeve monetises volatility regime transition
tasks.description: The book holds 31 nominal sleeves at an effective breadth of 1.324 (4 of 15 declared phenomena occupied). Volatility regime transition is EMPTY. Who pays: Anyone sized for the volatility that just ended. A regime change forces them to re-size at the worst moment. What to hunt: Compression that precedes expansion, expansion that mean-reverts, and the change point itself -- traded as a state, not as a level. Because k_eff = n/(1+(n-1)rho) is concave in n, the FIRST sleeve of an unoccupied phenomenon buys more breadth than the next five inside an occupied one -- propose a mechanism whose payer is the one named here, on the MT5/Fusion universe, not a re-parameterisation of what the book already trades.

tasks.title: No sleeve monetises trend and momentum
tasks.description: The book holds 31 nominal sleeves at an effective breadth of 1.324 (4 of 15 declared phenomena occupied). Trend and momentum is EMPTY.
